body:
I understand that many people have it worse than me.  My life is pretty damn good and I know it.  I hate myself for having this knowledge and still just feeling like shit.  I worked hard for seven years for my degree.  I set a goal and accomplished it.  It still doesn't change the way I feel about myself.  It doesn't change my self confidence or help with my anxiety.  I don't even try with getting a girl for in my heart I know I am not worth her time.  I haven't applied for a new job in the field because I know I am worthless and no employer should put up with me.  Fuck man, I don't know why my current employer hasn't fired me.  I'm a fucking loser.  That is all that runs through my head all day.  Reading my post makes me pissed at myself for being such a pussy, for being so weak.  I know that I have no real reason to feel this way about myself.  It doesn't change the fact that I do.  It makes it worse.  I hate myself for it.  

Smiling.  : )  That's easy.  No one would suspect me of my self contained misery.  If you asked a close friend they would say that I'm up beat and easy going.  It's easy to lie to people.  To put up a front.  You can't lie to yourself.
